content: Audio capture belongs in Rust core: dictad already reports level 0..1 + state in its status JSON (dicta-ui polls every 100ms) — Flutter dashboard can reuse the same polling, zero new audio deps on Linux. For the Windows skeleton, cpal 0.18.2 (Aug 2026) is the standard Rust audio crate: WASAPI default backend on Windows (Win 8+/10), native PipeWire backend on Linux (feature pipewire, selection PipeWire>PulseAudio>ALSA), MSRV 1.85. Dart record/* packages are mobile-oriented and fmedia-based — not needed.
